# Techtonic Lab

> Techtonic Lab is an IT training institute based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India,
> offering courses in Data Analytics, Data Science, and SAP with placement
> preparation and support. Courses are delivered in classroom, blended, and
> weekend formats. All three courses cost Rs 50,000 for a four-month programme
> (three months of core training plus one month of corporate grooming).

## Courses

- [Data Analyst Course in Nagpur](https://techtoniccorporate.com/data-analytics-course): 3-month programme covering Microsoft Excel, SQL, Python, Microsoft Power BI and Tableau Desktop, plus 1 month of corporate grooming. Fee Rs 50,000. Next batch 18 August 2026.
- [Data Science Course in Nagpur](https://techtoniccorporate.com/data-science-course): Python, pandas, scikit-learn, applied statistics, machine learning and real-world projects. Fee Rs 50,000. Next batch 25 August 2026.
- [SAP Course in Nagpur](https://techtoniccorporate.com/sap-course): Modules include SAP FICO, SAP MM, SAP SD and SAP PP/QM with live SAP S/4HANA server access and certification guidance. Fee Rs 50,000. Next batch 11 August 2026.

## Fees and batches

- [Course fees](https://techtoniccorporate.com/fees): Rs 50,000 all-inclusive for any course, or roughly Rs 8,334 per month over a 6-month EMI. No separate registration, examination or certificate charges.
- [Batch schedule](https://techtoniccorporate.com/batches)

## Placement

- [Placement records](https://techtoniccorporate.com/placements): 11 named alumni on record. Techtonic Lab provides placement assistance, not a placement guarantee.
- [Hire from us](https://techtoniccorporate.com/hire-from-us): No placement fee for employers. Shortlist within four working days.
